headline: Monday at the Lake: Cool & crisp with plenty of sunshine
lede: Monday, September 21 brings cool highs near 84°F (28.7°C) under mostly sunny skies with a low chance of rain. A refreshing change after recent heat — perfect for a full day exploring Branson without the humidity.

featured.title: Branson Landing Fountain Show

plan.title: Table Rock Sunrise Fishing
plan.detail: Launch early for calm water and active bass near main lake points and brush piles. Walleye and crappie also active in cooler mornings.
